description: REMOVED 2026-09-26: TikTok deleted the public Creative Center song chart (TikTok One migration). Every call answers 410 Gone (ENDPOINT_REMOVED) at 0 credits. Will be re-enabled if TikTok restores the chart. Use tiktok_popular_hashtags / tiktok_trending_videos / tiktok_popular_creators for TikTok trends. Costs 2 credits. Empty results and failures are never charged. Pass cache=true for a free 24h cache hit (default always fresh).

cache.description: Set true to serve from the 24h response cache (0 credits on hit). Default false — always fetch fresh.

limit.description: Max items to return (default 20, max 20). Flat 2 credits per call.

newOnBoard.description: Only sounds newly on the Top 100.

page.description: Creative Center page (1–20). Echoed on a native chart 200 with hasMore. Omitted on the extended path — that list is one page.

name: tiktok_popular_songs
